notes.title: Major update - 1.0.05
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/ac3067f18737e25e32fbf54759aba2f50249441f.png"]

New character: Anubis the Immortal!

Fires scythes that home on an enemy until it dies.

Spell that freezes enemies around you.

IMMORTAL: Once Anubis joins you, he is there for good. If Anubis dies during a stage, he will return to your roster so you can always have him in your party (but he will lose some levels on death).

UNIQUE: Anubis is one of a kind, a special hero, a god of death. So you can only have one.

You can unlock Anubis by killing his Boss version, which is waiting for you at the end of the endless mode.

Includes new Steam achievements for Anubis.



New game mode: Boss Rush!

Get swarmed by bosses and see if you can survive for a full hour!

All of the enemies are mini-boss versions of the normal enemies, plus frequent “caged” boss events.

Unlock after completing stage 5.

New Steam achievements for progressing in Boss Rush mode.



Balance changes:

Most stages are now longer and more difficult.

Rebalanced enemies: Most are faster and have higher HP, but lower damage.

Healing potions can now be attracted from a distance, making them easier to collect.

Limited damage to characters, so even a very powerful enemy will not one-shot you immediately.

notes.title: 1 DAY LEFT TO UNLEASH THE HEROES!
notes.content:
Hey, Heroes! The day we've all been waiting for is almost here! Get ready because tomorrow, APRIL 3RD, our party is about to grow with the release of FUR AND FABLES.

Mark your calendars and get ready! If you haven’t already done so, remember to WISHLIST the game.

We’d like to take a moment to thank all of you for your continued support! We can’t wait to share this next chapter with you—it's a huge step forward for us, and we’re so proud of what’s ahead.

Watch our latest teaser trailer to celebrate this exciting moment!

Endless Mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/9c209ae2419ad1cf8dad1363498e272097b5e403.png

We decided to bring you the ultimate test of skill, Endless Mode. Plunge into a never-ending challenge where waves of enemies grow more substantial, and so do you. Compete for high scores, push your limits, prove yourself, and be the last man standing!

Once you enter the endless mode, you must use every trick in the book to survive for as long as possible. Just like in the regular stages, gold and experience points can be collected and used - it’s a good place for farming!

Do note that any characters you take will, positively, 100% DIE, so think about your loved ones before clicking that button and sending them to their doom.

When the last character in your party - and I can’t stress this enough - DIES, you will get a score based on the time you survived. The endless mode - like everything in life - isn’t endless. It has a limit of 100 minutes*, but legend has it that no adventurer has ever survived for even half of that! How long can you go?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/693157f170fede0001cb963db0ea7fb09579da24.png

Party Synergies

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/13885eae74b32c9dc59f201e67608a583a99a4b5.gif

Party Synergies are a new type of power-up that can be discovered during gameplay.
Each synergy gives you a unique item that helps the entire party. These are not 10% buffs to whatever, but new items that can impact how you play.

Each synergy needs specific party members to activate. Once you discover the synergy, you can see the required characters in the Synergies menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/dc898d7be355d047709819b70a2a19c9cc46b9e7.png

You can have multiple synergies active simultaneously if your party meets all the requirements!
In addition to the cool extra effect, this feature is designed to encourage players to explore new party combinations and compositions.

In this case, trying out new characters and how they interact with each other!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/750f0848ff26b351ed059a08a82fb62d91885c56.png

New Character: The Alchemist

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/ce7197e4a9247e62b73399b7f006ded02feb8add.gif

The Alchemist throws vials that create pools of poison when they explode. The attacks have the Poison damage type right from the start, and both stay on the ground and deal damage to enemies over time.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/fa128910a2cedeacd53a401565787421647eefce.gif
Her spell boosts your entire party to Life Steal - perfect for getting out of sticky situations and making those nine lives stretch just a little longer.

The Alchemist will only be available in the full version of the game in early April.

New Character: The Cleric

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/4ad06fde24e198eb4b1b052b473b0025a2b33086.gif

The Cleric’s basic attack is a divine aura that damages enemies if they get too close.

Activating the Cleric’s spell will significantly boost your party’s healing for a few seconds, letting you survive long enough to regroup or save that one character you don’t want to lose.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/b85b5cc22f41a72d4e1c8a0c8b3f95d0796add05.gif

The Cleric will be available on the game’s full-release version in early April, with lots of extra content!

You will need to complete a quest to be able to recruit Clerics. Once you have them in your party, they will unlock some new Synergy options too - so be sure to try out new formations!

[hr][/hr]
Tomorrow will be the full release! Join our Discord Server to stay updated and participate in the discussion. We’ll also post trailers and updates on our YouTube channel. Wishlist the game now if you haven’t already!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2875810/Fur_and_Fables/

Catch you soon on Fabletown! ✌️

~ Fur and Fables Dev Team

notes.title: 2 DAYS LEFT TIL THE BATTLE BEGINS!
notes.content:
Hello Folks! Hope you are all ready because... WE'RE RELEASING THE GAME IN 2 DAYS FROM NOW! We can not wait for you to put your hands (or paws if you're an actual fur) onto the game!
Let’s continue the recap of the most important features coming to Fur and Fables! Shall we?


New Enemies
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/4bba83cb5da3c7fdd24ab64b208897a42588d0dd.gif
After several sketches and iterations, we came up with the rock enemies. Eric, the game’s graphic designer and animator, created a family of rock monsters different from our animal heroes.
They answer all the design principles we set out to achieve:

 They are made of stone and rock so players won’t be too sorry for them.
 We intentionally kept them neutral looking (no red eyes and sharp fangs).
 They have a distinct and limited color palette different from the main characters.
 They are unique to this world we created.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/d81d62bb1fb5ebfdc55c762be8e3c69f64071db3.gif
We wanted to mix things up with a completely different look and feel for the second wave of enemies. This time, we wanted to expand the world of Fur and Fables by creating something that would represent the darker side of our heroes.

These enemies are similar to our main characters but obviously from a different culture. They feature more skulls, horns, crude blades, and fur loinclothes.

Elemental Damage
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/5327391c135838012b363b364b043262bd874de7.gif

The new version of Fur and Fables adds elemental damage to the game. There are currently three types of damage:

 Cold: Enemies hit by cold damage are frozen in place temporarily (bosses and mini-bosses are slowed instead of stopped).
 Lightning: Chain lightning arcs from the enemy that was hit to a number of other enemies in range.
 Poison: Enemies suffer additional damage for a few seconds after being hit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/b27eeb24d1b9e49d24fae60852ce2e2ed6f7b89d.gif
You can give your characters an elemental damage buff by picking up an Upgrade Anvil in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/8f3f5710be05d213f7b330965a67aac075bf0331.gif
Each character can only have one damage type at a time, but the damage type resets after each stage, so you can try different combinations and test which element goes well with each character.
For example, Cold damage is especially useful on the Barbarian and Fighter, as they can both prevent enemies from getting too close.

Poison damage can be significant for characters with long-ranged attacks, such as the Wizard, as enemies will suffer the maximum damage over time before they get to the party.
Lightning damage works well with high-damage characters like the Rogue, making her precise but small crossbow bolt into an area-clearing machine.

But all elemental damage types can be helpful for all characters, so try them out and find what works best for you!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/880681e4cfc894b908769dec21d510c2cd12b6ce.gif
You can also create some synergies, like freezing an enemy and then poisoning it, ensuring the poison will have its full effect.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/284c370ddbd97a84eeb9d3ad9fac9fe344507cec.gif

[hr][/hr]
That’s everything for now, but come tomorrow for another recap! Join our Discord Server to stay updated and join the discussion. We’ll also be posting trailers and updates on our YouTube channel, and if you’d like to wishlist the game, you can do so now.
See you on April 3rd. ✌️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2875810/Fur_and_Fables/

~ Fur and Fables Dev Team

notes.title: 3 DAYS LEFT TIL FABLETOWN RISES!
notes.content:
The wait is almost over!

Hello, hello, Heroes! This is the final stretch for Fur and Fables to release...JUST 3 DAYS LEFT! 🔥 We're so happy about what the game looks like and all the new adventures you will face, from Endless Mode and powerful synergies to brand-new characters!
In these three days, we will recap all the most important features coming to the game. Let's go for it!

Controller Support and Steam Deck Compatibility

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/066126a512ce442fd214ca77ee1d0a353c5d8b8d.jpg
We are happily announcing that we have been hard at work and are doing our best to implement the feature you requested most: controller support.
We are finally announcing that Fur and Fables now support controllers, and yes, it's fully compatible with Steam Deck, too! 

New Leveling System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/8f25c6e2bd8c6f06352f51ac0f5d101ae92f05df.gif
We wanted to create a system that would allow for more control and choices and make the players more attached to their characters. So now, instead of leveling up automatically, you gather points and use them to select which characters you want to level up and when.
These new points stay with you between stages, so you can farm for them and gather as many as you need!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/85409306fe605dbf588560c3f4efda0b167f5ef6.gif
Because the level-up is now selective, you will generally level up much more slowly. To compensate for this, we modified the bonuses granted by leveling up so that each level grants you more significant bonuses than before.

UI Improvements + Party Reordering
The new level-up system also allowed us to show character stats more clearly: When you open the new Level-Up menu, you can see each character’s current stats and stats after level-up.
The menu adds another feature many players have requested for a long time: The option to switch places between party members mid-game freely. You can click the little arrows in the menu to move a character forward or backward in the line.

That’s everything for now, but come tomorrow for another recap! Join our Discord Server to stay updated and join the discussion. We’ll also be posting trailers and updates on our YouTube channel, and if you’d like to wishlist the game, you can do so now.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2875810/Fur_and_Fables/

~ Fur and Fables Dev Team

notes.title: Dev Log 7 - Towards the Release
notes.content:
Greeting Heroes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/0e3ee1ac960c8a5bac8d4ddb90e01f54eb29b6ad.png

As we’re getting close to the release of Fur and Fables, today we’ll do a series of tips for anyone getting into the game.

The Basics
Fur and Fables is a bullet-heaven roguelike. You control a party of animal heroes, each with their own attacks and special abilities.
Once your party of characters is ready, you’ll take them on adventures where they’ll have to survive for a set period of time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/54e8025dfc540e1c1e2287e1fa4b2b0a5894b35c.gif

Progression
When you defeat enemies, you’ll gain gold and experience points, both of which can be used to boost your permanent progression.
Experience points let you level-up your character. Characters’ stats are increased when they level up. And unlike a lot of games in the genre - your characters keep their levels, so the upgrade is permanent!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/3681c3ef2a765b191ddeb8e25c7add9304ba906d.gif

Gold lets you buy permanent upgrades such as more damage, attack size, starting with a larger party, and more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/110a8e20981cf49e755422e4ba59fac4fabac7a4.png

Party Management
Don’t get too attached to any one hero though, as in the world of Fur and Fables, life is but a fleeting shadow and one wrong move can spell the end of even the goodest of boys.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/c6757fa6c96c2baea5c74dc5b8ce9dd7d8783ff3.gif

However, you can always rescue more heroes during the game, and they will automatically join your party (if you have the space for them).
You can also recruit new heroes between stages. You should check it out regularly, as completing quests will unlock more character classes for you to recruit!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/dbbc88b5367b3369b79c8cd76d3cce18a6a5fafe.png

Trying out different party compositions can also unlock Party Synergies: Special bonuses that you only get when you have certain character classes in your party.
They can compensate for some weak spots or just help you out in more difficult situations, so try out new combinations and find what works best for you.

And More!
There’s a lot more to explore in Fur and Fables: Weapon evolutions, in-game upgrades, spells, elemental damage, an endless mode - and plenty of content to discover for yourself!

▶️ Fur and Fables is coming April 3rd to Steam. 🔥

Watch this space for more information, and join our Discord server for all of the latest updates and discussions!

notes.title: Fur and Fables is Joining Steam Next Fest! 🎉
notes.content:
Greetings Heroes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/470afa3d5ab8b77e698c08d8674da676c8ed6e29.jpg

We’re excited to announce that Fur and Fables will be part of Steam Next Fest! This is a big moment for us, and we can’t wait for both longtime supporters and new comers to experience the latest version of Fur and Fables.

In this special demo, you'll get to try out new quests, explore Party Synergies, and join our new Endless mode! Plus, we’ll be sharing more about what’s coming in the full release.

It’s been amazing to see our game grow, and I can’t wait to hear what you all think. Fur and Fables is now localized in Chinese (Simplified), German, Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), and Russian.

Welcome to all our new heroes! 🙌
[hr][/hr]
What’s in the demo? 3 stages + full access to the Endless Mode!
 6 character classes
 Quests
 A taste of the Party Synergies - just three in the demo
 Full localization to six languages: Chinese (simplified), German, Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), and Russian.
[hr][/hr]


New Character: The Cleric

Today you’ll meet another newcomer to our unlikely bunch of adventurers: the Cleric!
This rotund fellow might not look like much of an attacker, and that’s because, well, he isn’t.
But as every RPG player knows - every party needs a support character to heal your tanks and protect the damage dealers!
And if there’s one thing pigs are known for - it’s healing.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/4ad06fde24e198eb4b1b052b473b0025a2b33086.gif

Attack
The Cleric’s basic attack is a divine aura that damages enemies if they get too close. While very helpful in protecting the party, some keen-nosed adventurers have noticed that the aura smells a little pungent… Almost like a certain root vegetable… Eh, maybe the pig just ate too many onions.
In any case, the aura does relatively low damage, but it’s constantly on, and it has the Lightning damage type, allowing you to zap everything that comes close to the party.
Attack Size and Damage upgrades will really boost its efficiency, but extra projectiles and cooldown bonuses have no effect.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/b85b5cc22f41a72d4e1c8a0c8b3f95d0796add05.gif


Spell and Weapon Evolution
If there’s one thing Clerics are known for, it’s healing. Activating the Cleric’s spell will greatly boost your party’s healing for a few seconds, letting you survive long enough to regroup or saving that one character you really don’t want to lose.
The evolved aura is bigger and better in every way - dealing more damage as well as having a life steal bonus for that extra healing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/dee3c6d126df74bfaf26e0c137c26a25b2d1372d.gif

Unlocking the Cleric
The Cleric will be available on the game’s full release version in early April, together with lots of other extra content! You will need to complete a quest to be able to recruit Clerics. Once you have them in your party, they will unlock some new Synergy options too - so be sure to try out new formations!


More to come!

 The full game will have all 8 character classes, including their weapon evolutions and spells.
 10 playable stages with different biomes
 More party synergies to discover and unlock, to match your personal play style!
 More meta upgrades to help you on your journey


[hr][/hr]

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/646709e55aca39446db99c112cabc9aa96cf4367.png 

Catch you next time!
~Double Crow Games

notes.title: Dev Log 6 - Meet the Alchemist
notes.content:
Greetings heroes!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/866722ef4b173eeef952beed8296cccdc750596f.png
Today we’re introducing one of the new character classes that will be available in the full game: the Alchemist!
As you can see, the Alchemist is mysterious and somewhat evil - like all cats. Don’t try to pet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/ce7197e4a9247e62b73399b7f006ded02feb8add.gif
Attack
The Alchemist throws vials that create pools of poison when they explode. The attacks have the Poison damage type right from the start, and both stay on the ground and deal damage to enemies over time. However, the damage and attack speed aren’t very high.
This makes the Alchemist a great addition to the party when dealing with hordes of smaller enemies. Upgrades such as Attack Size and Extra Projectiles can make the Alchemist’s attack cover a huge area, and if you manage to pick up some Poison Duration upgrades during a stage, she can be the perfect crowd-control character.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/fa128910a2cedeacd53a401565787421647eefce.gif

Spell and Weapon Evolution
As a creature of pure malice (again, like all cats), the Alchemist is a specialist in sucking the soul out of her victims. That’s why her spell gives your entire party a boost to Lifesteal - perfect for getting out of sticky situations and making those nine lives stretch just a little longer.
Her weapon evolution creates a bigger and more potent version of the Poison Vial attack, with three base attacks. It’s also pink.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/4efae65fba7b35b411ebec6ed83a6bb75476dc77.gif

Unlocking the Alchemist
As befits most felines, you’ll have to do some work to befriend the Alchemist. The class will only be available to recruit after completing a quest, and you’ll need to complete a second quest to unlock her weapon evolution (like with all other character classes).
The Alchemist will only be available in the full version of the game in early April. Together with more stages, more content, and another new character - stay tuned!

[hr][/hr]

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/646709e55aca39446db99c112cabc9aa96cf4367.png 

Catch you next time!
~Double Crow Games

notes.title: Dev Log 5 - Party Synergies
notes.content:
Greetings heroes!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/97bd2d5bdd47010a961c368fbad045cd6edd003d.png
Today, we will discuss one of the most exciting features that many of you have been asking for. The new synergies are not only new features but will also change how you play the game, build your team, and choose which heroes to include on your team.

This will run deep in the game, so your team is no longer just characters. Still, it's dynamic and changeable with each hero you add. There are also lots of cool synergies to be added in the future, with the full release alongside the new characters opening a wide range of possibilities and team builds that will suit almost everyone. There are also more possibilities to explore.

Synergies was one of the most long-awaited features I have been working on, and I hope you all like it.

Thanks, and let's jump into more details about it.

Party Synergies
Party Synergies are a new type of power-up that can be discovered during gameplay.
Each synergy gives you a unique item that helps the entire party. These are not 10% buffs to whatever, but actual new items that can impact the way you play.
For example, here is BONEGRINDER!!! flail of the legendary hero Precious the Cruel, a toy poodle who saved the world hundreds of dog years ago.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/13885eae74b32c9dc59f201e67608a583a99a4b5.gif

Bonegrinder is always attached (by bones, of course) to the last character in the party, helping you to protect those more vulnerable members.

Discovering party synergies
Each synergy needs specific party members to activate. Once you discover the synergy, you can see the required characters in the Synergies menu:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/dc898d7be355d047709819b70a2a19c9cc46b9e7.png

You can see that Bonegrinder requires your party to have at least one fighter, one barbarian, and one wizard. They can be in any order, and you can add more characters to the party.
In fact - you can have more than one synergy active at the same time, if your party meets the requirements for all of them!
The synergy effect will be activated as soon as you have the required members in your party. Whether you start the stage with them or rescue them along the way.
However, if some of your characters die and your party no longer meets the requirements, the synergy effect will vanish.

Yes, really.

Yes, just like that.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/750f0848ff26b351ed059a08a82fb62d91885c56.png

Synergize your party
There are three synergies to discover in the demo, and there will be more coming in the full version of the game!
In addition to the cool extra effect, this feature is designed to encourage players to explore new party combinations and compositions. We know that players in any game will often stick to an optimal strategy that works, but our design philosophy is to nudge players towards ways to play that we think are more fun and rewarding.
In this case: trying out new characters and how they interact with each other!
Can you discover the two other synergies in the demo?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/3e789ac15d06c99e312749368c5132302957b10a.png

[hr][/hr]

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/646709e55aca39446db99c112cabc9aa96cf4367.png 

Catch you next time!
~Double Crow Games

notes.title: Dev Log 4 : introducing Endless Mode
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/c1f3142a26917e3076e9c3ae350293607802cf34.png

We didn’t want to leave you empty-handed with the holidays just approaching! It is a time of happiness and celebration, and we decided to bring you the ultimate test of skill, Endless Mode. Plunge into a never-ending challenge where waves of enemies grow stronger, and so do you. Compete for high scores, push your limits, prove yourself, and be the last man standing!
Lastly, before we jump on the real stuff, we wanted to say Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays! 🎄 We hope this update brings joy to your gaming sessions and makes this season even more special.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/9c209ae2419ad1cf8dad1363498e272097b5e403.png

Unlocking the Endless Mode
After you complete the three regular stages, you can access the endless mode.
Before entering the Endless Mode, you can select your party just like any other stage, using characters you already recruited (or you can use your level-up points to recruit new characters).
All characters retain their levels, and you can level them up during the endless mode run. Any meta upgrades purchased also apply, so taking a stronger party to the endless mode means you can survive longer.

Gameplay
Once you enter the endless mode, you must use every trick in the book to survive for as long as possible. Just like in the regular stages, gold and experience points can be collected and used - it’s a good place for farming!
Do note that any characters you take will absolutely, positively, 100% DIE, so think about your loved ones before clicking that button and sending them to their doom.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/693157f170fede0001cb963db0ea7fb09579da24.png

Tips and Tricks
Survivability is key, meaning defensive upgrades will help you score better. Extra hit points, damage reduction, healing, and lifesteal can boost your party’s chances of getting a new high score, but don’t forget to balance that with some damage upgrades so you can kill those enemies!
During the run, you will find new friends and upgrade anvils along the way - be sure to pick them up. And don’t forget to use your spells.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/1c584861449f8fd2569789a314799c7952ae4424.png

High Score
When the last character in your party - and I can’t stress this enough - DIES, you will get a score based on the time you survived. The endless mode - like everything in life - isn’t really endless. It has a limit of 100 minutes*, but legend has it that no adventurer has ever survived for even half of that! How long can you go? That’s 700 minutes in dog minutes.

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/646709e55aca39446db99c112cabc9aa96cf4367.png 

Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays!🎄
~Double Crow Games

notes.title: Fur and Fables X Bullet Heaven Fest 2.0
notes.content:
Hello, fellow Heroes!

As you may know, the Bullet Heaven genre has grown immensely over the last years; therefore, with many other Bullet Heaven games, we are happy to announce that we are joining Bullet Heaven 2.0 this year...

...it starts today!

BULLET HEAVEN 2.0 FEST IS HERE!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/78bd88e877876231e2fd1c3a75188e947b607d15.jpg
➡️ Click on the image to go directly to the events page

In this event, you'll find many games that populate the genre at a discounted price!
Of course, Fur and Fables will be a part of the festivities, featuring a Dev Stream showcasing our game and its exciting upcoming updates.
Not only that, but we also have updated our demo; here is what you expect to see.

New Enemies

I’d like to take this opportunity to talk about the game’s visual development and graphics, as the next version will feature a new family of enemies. Throughout the development of the game, we’re trying to keep things coherent and consistent to create a more real feeling to the world of Fur and Fables.

For the first group of enemies you encounter, we had a few design pillars:

 We don’t want the player to feel bad for defeating a large number of them..
 They shouldn’t be scary or too “evil”, to keep the cute vibe of the game.
 They need to be visually distinct from the main characters.
 No common fantasy tropes or races such as orcs, goblins, or zombies.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/4bba83cb5da3c7fdd24ab64b208897a42588d0dd.gif

After several sketches and iterations, we came up with the rock enemies. Eric, the game’s graphic designer and animator, created a family of rock monsters that were clearly different from our animal heroes. 

They answer all of the design principles we set out to achieve:

 They are made of stone and rock, so players won’t be too sorry for them
 We intentionally kept them looking kind of neutral looking (no red eyes and sharp fangs) 
 They have a distinct and limited color palette that’s different from the main characters 
 They are unique to this world we created


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/d81d62bb1fb5ebfdc55c762be8e3c69f64071db3.gif

For the second wave of enemies, we wanted to mix things up with a completely different look and feel. To expand the world of Fur and Fables, this time we wanted to create something that would represent the darker mirror of our heroes. Our animal heroes are, well, heroes! So what would animal villains look like?
By the time players reach this new group of enemies, they should be familiar enough with the game that we don’t have to be so careful with keeping everything extremely clear - both visually and morally.

These enemies are much more similar to our main characters, but obviously from a different culture. They feature more skulls, horns, crude blades, and fur loin clothes. We drew inspiration from fantasy artists like Frank Frazetta and Simon Bisley, and from “Sword and Sorcery” classics such as Conan the Barbarian and He-Man.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/4038d5ebad1f225a165113eb62012e37ce55a810.png

The new barbarian enemies will be featured in the next version of Fur and Fables.


Elemental damage

The new version of Fur and Fables adds elemental damage to the game. There are currently three types of damage:

 Cold: Enemies hit by cold damage are frozen in place temporarily (bosses and mini-bosses are slowed instead of stopped).
 Lightning: Chain lightning arcs from the enemy that was hit to a number of other enemies in range.
 Poison: Enemies suffer additional damage for a few seconds after being hit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/5327391c135838012b363b364b043262bd874de7.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/b27eeb24d1b9e49d24fae60852ce2e2ed6f7b89d.gif
You can give your characters an elemental damage buff by picking up an Upgrade Anvil in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/8f3f5710be05d213f7b330965a67aac075bf0331.gif
Each character can only have one damage type at a time, but the damage type resets after each stage, so you can try different combinations and test which element goes well with each character.
For example, Cold damage is especially useful on the Barbarian and Fighter, as they can both prevent enemies from getting too close.

New Endeless Mode Event 🔥

Lastly don't forget to check out our latest Endless Game Mode
- Become the last man standing on our new Endless mode!

How to Take Part⁉️
  Open Fur and Fables.
  When you are in the stages menu, choose Endless Mode at the bottom!
  The longer you play and survive, the greater your chances of winning
  Share your best time with us. Here 
End Date 📅 
▶️ Ends December the 19th.

Rules 📕
  Only one entry is allowed. If you send a second submission, we will send you a DM asking which one you want to keep, and the one you didn’t choose will be deleted;
  Entries sent after the end date will not be accepted.
Prizes 🏆
 🥇1st place: $50 Steam gift card
 🥈2nd place: $25 Steam gift card
 🥉3rd place: $10 Steam gift card

May the odds be with you 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/646709e55aca39446db99c112cabc9aa96cf4367.png

Enjoy the fest and happy adventuring!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Dev Log 3 - Elemental Damage and Synergies
notes.content:
Welcome back, fellow heroes, 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/f1ff36bfea94a9d8b198d20d94d9ce2963da0846.jpg

It’s been a while since we talked and shared what we are working on. So, let’s catch up!

 In today’s dev log, we’re excited to dive into our newly added feature elemental damage, share our thoughts, and work on progress regarding the highly anticipated feature party synergies - a feature I know many of you are eager for.

Without any further ado, let's jump in.

Elemental damage

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/5327391c135838012b363b364b043262bd874de7.gif

The new version of Fur and Fables adds elemental damage to the game. There are currently three types of damage:

 Cold: Enemies hit by cold damage are frozen in place temporarily (bosses and mini-bosses are slowed instead of stopped).
 Lightning: Chain lightning arcs from the enemy that was hit to a number of other enemies in range.
 Poison: Enemies suffer additional damage for a few seconds after being hit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/b27eeb24d1b9e49d24fae60852ce2e2ed6f7b89d.gif
You can give your characters an elemental damage buff by picking up an Upgrade Anvil in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/8f3f5710be05d213f7b330965a67aac075bf0331.gif
Each character can only have one damage type at a time, but the damage type resets after each stage, so you can try different combinations and test which element goes well with each character.
For example, Cold damage is especially useful on the Barbarian and Fighter, as they can both prevent enemies from getting too close.

Poison damage can be significant for characters with long-ranged attacks, such as the Wizard, as enemies will suffer the maximum damage over time before they get to the party.
Lightning damage works well with high-damage characters like the Rogue, making her precise but small crossbow bolt into an area-clearing machine.

But all elemental damage types can be helpful for all characters, so try them out and find what works best for you!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/880681e4cfc894b908769dec21d510c2cd12b6ce.gif
You can also create some synergies, like freezing an enemy and then poisoning it, ensuring the poison will have its full effect.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/284c370ddbd97a84eeb9d3ad9fac9fe344507cec.gif
Speaking of synergies…


Party Synergies
The next big feature we’re working on is party synergies. We wanted to create a system that encourages players to experiment with different party combinations and that would add more depth and discovery to the game.
The idea is that when certain character combinations are together in the party, you’ll get a unique effect that helps the entire party and is more than just another passive buff to some stats. Instead, you might get a shield that revolves around the whole party, a flail dragged behind you and damages enemies, or an aura of healing… All based on the composition of your party.

This feature is still early in development and will take some time before it's ready for players to get their paws on it (and some things will probably change along the way).
But if you want more updates on when the Synergies will be added and all of the most recent news about the game, make sure to wishlist Fur and Fables and join our Discord server!

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/646709e55aca39446db99c112cabc9aa96cf4367.png 

Until next time - Happy hunting!
~Double Crow Games

notes.title: Dev Log 1 - Controller support
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow travelers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/637b69adf7152c93569dba8fe5d621ed22cdcdd9.png

Welcome to our first-ever Dev log for Fur and Fables. We have lots to talk about and share with you, including where we are right now, what we are working on, and what is planned for the future. But before all that, we would like to take a moment to thank everyone who has shared their feedback with us and wishlisted the game. We really encourage you to share your feedback with us if you haven't yet, and also share Fur and Fables with your friends.

Additionally, in the upcoming weeks, we will share more Dev Logs with you so that you are always aware of where we are at and stay up to date with the game's latest developments.

This brings us to today's Dev Log, and we are happily announcing that we have been hard at work, doing our best to implement the feature you requested most: controller support.

We are finally announcing that Fur and Fables now supports controllers.🎉

But that's not all that we have today for you. We also want to introduce you to our new leveling system:
In the earlier versions of the game, your characters would level up automatically when they gain enough experience. That system “worked” in the sense of allowing players to progress but was somewhat limited and lacking in player agency.
We wanted to create a system that would both allow for more control and choices and would make the players more attached to their characters. So now, instead of leveling up automatically, you gather points and use them to select which characters you want to level up and when. These points are dropped by enemies you kill - similar to the way experience points worked before - with more powerful enemies giving you more points.
These new points also stay with you between stages, so you can farm for them and gather as many as you need!

Now that you have to choose how to upgrade your characters, we hope that players will be more emotionally invested in the choice and in the characters themselves.
Would you rather level up a low-level character to help it survive and contribute more to the party? Or will you save all of your points to level up that one character to be super powerful?
Both paths are valid but result in different play styles and party compositions.

Because the level-up is now selective, that means you will, in general, level up much more slowly. To compensate for this, we modified the bonuses granted by leveling up so that each level grants you more significant bonuses than before.
This is a new system that we know isn’t perfectly balanced yet, so we’d really appreciate your feedback! Especially on how fast you think the progression should be, and how powerful it should feel to gain a level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/8f25c6e2bd8c6f06352f51ac0f5d101ae92f05df.gif

The new level-up system also gave us the opportunity to show character stats in a much more clear way: When you open the new Level-Up menu, you’ll be able to see each character’s current stats and what its stats will be after level-up.
The menu adds another feature that a lot of players have requested for a long time: The option to freely switch places between party members mid-game. You can click on the little arrows in the menu to move a character forward or backward in the line, allowing you to place that fighter you just picked up in the front where he should be and protect your weaker characters by placing them in the middle of the party.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/85409306fe605dbf588560c3f4efda0b167f5ef6.gif

In the end, thank you for your support and feedback. It has been nothing but fuel that has made us work harder and harder on the game to meet your expectations.

Lastly, if you haven't yet, make sure to wishlist Fur and Fables and share it with your friends and don't forget to join our Discord server.

~ Fur and Fables Dev Team
